title: pi.setSessionName() does not refresh terminal title (asymmetric with built-in /name command)
body:
## Summary

The extension API `pi.setSessionName()` persists a `session_info` entry but does not refresh the terminal title. The built-in `/name` command does both. As a result, renaming the session from an extension leaves the tab/window title stale until the next unrelated event triggers `updateTerminalTitle()` (e.g. rebind after `/reload`, session switch).

## Reproduce

1. Write a tiny extension that calls `pi.setSessionName("hello world")` (or use [`pi-session-rename`](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/pi-extensions/tree/main/packages/pi-session-rename) from a public fork).
2. Start pi in a terminal emulator that displays OSC 2 titles (iTerm2, Ghostty, WezTerm, Alacritty with default config, GNOME Terminal, etc.).
3. Run the extension path that calls `pi.setSessionName(...)`.

**Expected:** tab title updates to `π - hello world - <cwd>` (same as `/name hello world`).
**Actual:** tab title stays on the previous form until the next `updateTerminalTitle()` call. Running `/resume` back into the same session refreshes it.

## Root cause

`pi.setSessionName()` in the extension runtime maps to `sessionManager.appendSessionInfo(name)` only:

- [`packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts:2168-2170`](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts#L2168-L2170) — extension-side binding
- [`packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts:2649-2651`](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts#L2649-L2651) — public method on `AgentSession`

Meanwhile, `/name` does both the append **and** the title refresh:

- [`packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts:5016-5017`](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts#L5016-L5017)

```ts
this.sessionManager.appendSessionInfo(name);
this.updateTerminalTitle();   // ← not called from the extension path
```

`updateTerminalTitle()` otherwise only fires on rebind (`rebindCurrentSession`, around L1609) and session shutdown (around L1795), so any standalone call to `pi.setSessionName()` from an extension is invisible to the terminal title.

## Suggested fix

Two reasonable options:

| # | Approach | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Have `AgentSession.setSessionName()` emit an event (e.g. a new `session_info_changed` or reuse `session_start`-style notification) that `InteractiveMode` subscribes to and calls `updateTerminalTitle()` from. | Cleanest — keeps the interactive-title concern inside interactive mode, and RPC/JSON/Print modes ignore the event as they do today. |
| 2 | Have `InteractiveMode` wrap the extension action and call `updateTerminalTitle()` after delegating. | Smaller diff but couples the wrapper to this specific action. |

Option 1 is also forward-compatible with a future `session_info_changed` extension event that other extensions might want (e.g. status bars).

## Workaround for extension authors

Call `ctx.ui.setTitle("<session> - <cwd>")` yourself right after `pi.setSessionName(...)`. That updates the tab immediately; pi's own next `updateTerminalTitle()` call (on rebind / session switch) then replaces it with the canonical `π - <session> - <cwd>` form — which now also contains the new name because `sessionManager.getSessionName()` has been updated.

Reference: [pi-session-rename/src/index.ts `refreshTerminalTitle()`](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/pi-extensions/blob/main/packages/pi-session-rename/src/index.ts).

## Environment

- pi `0.70.2`
- macOS / Ghostty (also reproduces under tmux + iTerm2 with default `set-titles` on)
